interface.name: zsingularity_tiling_manager_v1
interface.description: This interface allows a client to manage window geometry for tiling purposes.

request.name: get_geometry
request.description: Requests the current geometry of a toplevel. The compositor replies with a single "geometry" event for that toplevel. Used by session save to capture exact window position/size/output.

event.name: geometry
event.description: Sent in response to get_geometry. output is the connector name (e.g. "DP-2"); maximized/fullscreen are 0/1.

request.name: set_geometry
request.description: Sets the geometry of a toplevel window.

request.name: set_tiled
request.description: Sets the tiled state of a window (removes decorations etc).

request.name: snap_view
request.description: Snaps the view to a screen edge using internal compositor logic.

request.name: move_to_workspace
request.description: Moves a toplevel to the workspace at the given zero-based index, without requiring it to be focused. Used by the overview to drag a window onto another workspace.

request.name: get_workarea
request.description: Requests the usable area of the output containing a toplevel, excluding space reserved by layer surfaces.

request.name: set_scrolling_mode
request.description: Enables compositor interaction rules for the scrolling layout.

request.name: detach_tiled

description.summary: detach a tiled window at its current geometry

request.description: Returns a scrolling tiled window to floating state without restoring the geometry it had before entering the layout.

event.name: interaction
event.description: Reports compositor-owned move and resize progress so the shell can keep the rest of the scrolling strip attached to the grabbed window.

request.name: set_drop_preview

description.summary: show a scrolling layout drop target

request.description: Sets or clears the compositor overlay used to preview the destination of an interactive scrolling layout move.

request.name: get_tileable

description.summary: query whether a toplevel can join the scrolling layout

request.description: Requests whether a toplevel is a normal window rather than a dialog or transient child.

request.name: set_close_gesture_progress

description.summary: set the close gesture visual progress

request.description: Desaturates a toplevel as it approaches the close threshold. A value of zero clears the effect.

request.name: get_layout_workarea

description.summary: query the combined output work area

request.description: Requests the common usable area across the output layout so a scrolling layout can span every output as one continuous viewport.

event.name: layout_output_workarea
event.description: Reports one usable output rectangle within the combined layout.

event.name: layout_workarea_done
event.description: Sent after every output work area has been reported.

request.name: get_cursor_position
request.description: Requests the current cursor position in output layout coordinates.

request.name: set_geometry_animated

description.summary: set a toplevel geometry and slide it there

request.description: Like set_geometry, but the compositor slides the window from its current position to the new one on the output frame clock. The client only receives the final size, once. Compositors without animations, or with reduced motion, apply the geometry directly.
